meaning.en: and stands spread out at all times
meaning.hi: और हर समय फैला हुआ रहता है

meaning.en: now, the colors of these five
meaning.hi: अब इन पाँचों के रंग

meaning.en: beginning with prana, taken in their order
meaning.hi: प्राण से शुरू करते हुए, क्रम से

meaning.en: red in color, radiant like a gemstone
meaning.hi: लाल रंग, रत्न जैसी चमक वाला

meaning.en: this is how the vital breath prana is described
meaning.hi: इस तरह प्राण-वायु बताई गई है

meaning.en: apana, in the region between the others
meaning.hi: अपान, उन दोनों के बीच में

meaning.en: has the glow of the scarlet rain-beetle
meaning.hi: बारिश के लाल कीड़े जैसी आभा वाला

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: samana, in between the two of them
meaning.hi: समान, उन दोनों के बीच में

meaning.en: has a shine as white as cow's milk
meaning.hi: गाय के दूध जैसी सफ़ेद चमक वाला

meaning.en: udana is pale, whitish throughout
meaning.hi: उदान पूरी तरह पीला-सफ़ेद है

meaning.en: vyana carries the same glow as a flame
meaning.hi: व्यान लौ जैसी आभा रखता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the one whose breath has broken through this circle
meaning.hi: जिसकी साँस इस मंडल को भेदकर

meaning.en: and risen to the crown of the head
meaning.hi: सिर के शिखर तक जा पहुँचती है

meaning.en: let him die wherever and whenever he may
meaning.hi: वह कहीं भी और कभी भी मरे

meaning.en: he is not born again — this is the hidden teaching
meaning.hi: वह दोबारा जन्म नहीं लेता — यही गुह्य शिक्षा है
